text:
maria: Quick sync from the PM yesterday - postmortem follow-ups are drifting. We need a smaller, mandatory "follow-up" checklist so owners and dates don't vanish.
sam: Agreed. One named owner per action or it becomes "team responsibility" and nobody acts.
kevin: Can we also standardize target windows? e.g. P0 emergency fixes: 1 week, P1: 2 weeks, P2: 4 weeks. Keeps priority aligned with business risk.
anya: Minimal follow-up item fields I like: Owner, Priority, Due, Acceptance / Verification steps, Rollback plan (if risky), Recurrence flag.
maria: Raw draft template (short):
Owner: <person>
Priority: P0/P1/P2
Due: YYYY-MM-DD
Verify: link to smoke/tests
Done criteria: e.g. "no write errors for 7d, 99th latency < X%"
Recurring?: yes/no + notes
Postmortem: <url>
Notes: short RCA + mitigation
oliver: Add a comms cadence line: who to ping at 24h / 72h, and whether to publish an update to #customer-facing?
jess: Suggest a simple cadence: daily status while open, then weekly until closed. Also: have the IC run a 15-min checkin ~48h post-incident to confirm owners.
sam: Automation idea: create GH issue from postmortem with that template, and wire a webhook to post slack reminders at 24h/72h and when due_date approaches.
incident-bot: Tip: Use `/remind` for channel reminders and GitHub Actions to label/close tracker items automatically when CI verification passes.
maria: For IC rotation: propose 2-week rotations and add a shadow for big releases so knowledge isn't lost mid-deploy. Keeps people fresh during high-change weeks.
kevin: Shorter rotations make sense operationally. Ops needs an easy edit flow for the rota calendar.
anya: I'll update the oncall sheet with a mandatory handoff row: open incidents, open actions, assigned owners, outstanding risks.
jess: I'll add a CI smoke job and a verification checklist that writes back to the GH issue when green.
maria: Plan: I'll create the GH issue template + an initial tracker board today, assign preliminary owners for outstanding KV actions (kevin: mitigation, jess: verifications, sam: reminders automation) and post links here by EOD. If no blockers, we ship the template into the postmortem checklist next week.
sam: I'm happy to help wire the automation.
kevin: ack.
maria: Thanks everyone, will share the GH links and reminder commands later. :pray:
